storyTemplate.title: Sandbox Supernatural Story
storyTemplate.description: A supernatural start: enter a town where the impossible is routine and investigate the first strange sign.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
The covered bridge creaks though there is no wind.

Moonhollow waits beyond the creek, lights warm in the windows and shadows too long beneath the trees. On the bridge rail, fresh claw marks cut through old paint beside a bundle of wildflowers tied with black thread.

The town is close, but the first sign is right here.
